entities.name: Jakob Kölliker
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jakob "Köbi" Kölliker is a Swiss former professional ice hockey defenceman and current head coach of the Chinese women's national ice hockey team, and the Chinese men's national junior ice hockey team. During his playing career, he represented Switzerland at the Winter Olympics in 1976 and 1988, serving as team captain at the later. He was inducted into the IIHF Hall of Fame in 2007.
